{{Stub}} {{Location Infobox |title = Whining Aix's Mire |image = Whining Aix's Mire.png |map = Solaris-3 |type = Region |nation = Huanglong }} '''Whining Aix's Mire''' is a region in [[Huanglong]]. It consists of many landforms, ruins and buildings. There is a giant storm blocking movement into it in the middle of the region. The storm is later cleared out during the [[Stygian Lacrimosa]] quest. ==Areas== {| class="article-table alternating-colors-table tdc1" style="width: 100%;" ! style="width: 200px;" |Name !Image !Description |- id="Court of Savanatae" |[[Court of Savantae Ruins]] |[[File:Court ruins.png|180px]]
